files.reason: CP2's sidecar: the host-side argv builders for its container (create, start, the ctl exec by recorded id, rm) and the in-container serve/ctl program, its whole-tree snapshotter (never following a link, never opening a special file), its inotify watcher over the consequential paths behind an injected factory, and its health records, writing exactly graders/endstate.py's evidence layout; round 3 had no sidecar.
Tests for box/sidecar.py (interface 3), on fakes only: a fake runtime, fake watcher streams and an injected clock, with the endstate round trip and a mutant asserted red for every guard.

CP2's commit scan: before a take's commit, every file of it is scanned for each secret's exact value (login values read at run time by its own read_login, the account email handed in), for holdout wordings only through an injected matcher (ruling C4; without one the result records not-checked), and through an injected rules scanner; agent-text hits are masked in place (never deleted) and counted as events, any other hit refuses the commit. Round 3 had none (its scrub.py removes one field).
Tests for box/scan_record.py (interface 3) on planted fake values, a fake rules scanner and a fake holdout matcher over synthetic strings, with a mutant asserted red for every guard.
